aggressive: The Boyz roar and surge forward in a wall of choppas.
A big one bellows 'WAAAGH!' and the mob charges.
guarded: The Boyz crouch behind a toppled ore cart, shooting wildly.
evasive: The mob scatters between the drill rigs, looking for a better angle.

aggressive: Grizzgut lowers his head and revs his choppa. 'OI! YOU! STAND STILL!'
guarded: Grizzgut hunkers behind a slab of stolen hull plate, grinning.
evasive: Grizzgut sidles toward the vault tunnels, eyeing the loot behind him.

aggressive: A grot waves a stolen cutting torch at you, screeching.
guarded: The grots hide behind a pile of vault rubble, peering out.
evasive: The grots scatter into the dark corridors, giggling.

aggressive: The jailers rattle their keys and charge.
guarded: The jailers slam a cell door and wait behind the bars.
evasive: A jailer backs toward the alarm klaxon.

aggressive: Krugrot swings a ring of keys the size of a shield. 'NOBODY LEAVES MY CELLS!'
guarded: Krugrot stands in the cell-block doorway, filling it.
evasive: Krugrot edges toward the stunty prisoner, meaning to use her as a shield.

aggressive: Zogbad roars and leaps off a mining rig at you.
guarded: Zogbad hunkers behind a stolen ore hauler.

aggressive: The guards come at you with shock-prods crackling.
guarded: The guards form up behind the camp gate.
evasive: A guard runs for the prisoner pens to cut the chains.

aggressive: Gutrip cracks a chain whip and charges.
guarded: Gutrip plants his feet in front of the pens.
evasive: Gutrip shoves a prisoner toward you and circles away.

leverage.text: you know the muster needs its slaves alive

aggressive: Grizzgut bellows: 'REMEMBER ME?! I GOT NEW ARMOUR!' and charges.
guarded: Grizzgut hunches behind his new plate. 'Not fallin' for dat again.'
evasive: Grizzgut circles the pit wall, playing to the crowd.

leverage.text: you talked him down once before
you know he wants a rematch he can win

aggressive: Bonecrusha swings both fists overhead. The crowd roars.
guarded: Bonecrusha waits, arms wide, inviting you to try.
evasive: Bonecrusha stomps around the edge, letting the crowd chant.

aggressive: The boarders lower their shoulders and charge down the corridor.
guarded: They brace behind a bulkhead door.
evasive: One edges toward your cargo bay, eyes darting.

aggressive: The 'Ard Boyz lock shields and charge down the corridor, roaring.
A wall of armoured Orks lowers its choppas and comes on.
guarded: The 'Ard Boyz brace behind a bulkhead door and dare you to come closer.
evasive: The Boyz fall back through the hatchways, trying to draw you deeper into the ship.

aggressive: A swarm of grots rushes you with wrenches and very sharp screwdrivers.
guarded: The grots huddle behind a sparking generator, giggling.
evasive: The grots scatter into the ducts. You hear them everywhere at once.

leverage.text: you know how his weapon works
you hold the key to his machine

aggressive: Gitzbolt fires up a shokk-attack gun far too big for him. "STAND STILL, I'M TESTIN' SUMFINK!"
guarded: Gitzbolt hides behind a crackling force field and starts tinkering with it.
evasive: Gitzbolt hops onto a rattling jump-pack and lurches toward the escape pods.

aggressive: Grizzgut stamps forward on a mechanical leg made from your fleet's scrap. "DIS TIME, STUNTY!"
guarded: Grizzgut raises a shield cut from a Votann hull plate. You recognise the rune on it.
evasive: Grizzgut circles, grinning. He has learned a thing or two since the pit.

aggressive: Skragnak roars loud enough to shake the deck and comes at you like a falling mountain.
The Warboss hefts his power klaw and charges.
guarded: Skragnak plants his feet and lets you come to him, klaw raised, grinning.
evasive: Skragnak paces sideways, sizing you up. He is enjoying this.

aggressive: His klaw sparks and sputters, but Skragnak charges anyway, furious.
guarded: Skragnak hunches in his dead armour, waiting for you to make a mistake.
evasive: Skragnak glances at his Boyz. They are not cheering any more. He backs away.

aggressive: Skragnak, half in his armour, swings a klaw he has not finished strapping on.
guarded: Skragnak drags a gun-servitor in front of himself and bellows for his guards.
evasive: Skragnak stumbles back toward his landing craft, roaring for anyone at all.

aggressive: Three Meganobz stomp forward in clanking armour, klaws snapping.
guarded: The Meganobz form a wall of metal in front of their Warboss.
evasive: The Meganobz spread out to come at you from three sides.
